summary.zh: 用投放数据算出 ROAS、CPA 与漏斗各环节流失
summary.en: Work out ROAS, CPA and funnel drop-off from your campaign data

description.zh: 根据你提供的投放数据，算 ROAS、CPA、ROI，做多触点归因，并定位漏斗中丢单最多的环节。适合想弄清哪个渠道或广告真正有效、钱花在哪浪费、转化为何下滑时使用。需要你给出各渠道的投放与转化数字。
description.en: Uses the numbers you provide to compute ROAS, CPA and ROI, run multi-touch attribution and find the funnel step losing the most. Use it to see which channel or ad works, where spend is wasted, or why conversions fell. You supply data.
